title: Share a public pack link
description: Copy a public pack link and open its dedicated release page with playlist and usage terms.

steps.caption: 1. Open Your Samples and select Packs to manage a public Sample Pack.
2. Open Jungle Toolkit. Its page includes the playlist and usage licence.
3. Choose Share pack, then External link.
4. Copy the link. Guests receive short previews; full playback and downloads need sign-in.
5. Open the link to see the dedicated release page. Sample reuse rights remain licence-controlled.
